items.labelEn: Building one Ford Model T with the old stationary method
items.labelFr: Assembler une Ford T avec l'ancienne méthode à poste fixe
items.conditions: Time per car at Ford's Highland Park plant before the moving assembly line, when workers came to a car that stayed in place (before 1913).
items.conditionsFr: Temps par voiture à l'usine Ford de Highland Park avant la chaîne mobile, quand les ouvriers venaient à une voiture immobile (avant 1913).
items.locator: K-12 Research Guide: Assembly Line, answer text
items.quote: an extraordinary improvement over 12½ hours per car under the old stationary assembly methods
items.confidenceNotes: Historical figure from a museum educational page, not the original Ford time study. Widely repeated; the museum is the best accessible source.

items.labelEn: Building one Ford Model T on the moving assembly line
items.labelFr: Assembler une Ford T sur la chaîne de montage mobile
items.conditions: Rate reached once Ford's separate lines were merged into continuous moving lines (1913 to early 1914). The museum says 93 minutes; Ford's own history page rounds it to ninety minutes.
items.conditionsFr: Cadence atteinte quand les lignes séparées de Ford ont été réunies en chaînes mobiles continues (1913 à début 1914). Le musée donne 93 minutes ; la page d'histoire de Ford arrondit à quatre-vingt-dix minutes.
items.locator: K-12 Research Guide: Assembly Line, answer text; cross-check src-ford-moving-assembly-line ('built in only ninety minutes')
items.quote: A Model T was being produced every 93 minutes
items.confidenceNotes: Two sources (museum, manufacturer) agree on about 90 minutes. Both are secondary, and 'produced every 93 minutes' may be a production interval rather than the work time on one car. Other secondary sources give under 3 h or under 2 h for earlier stages.

items.labelEn: Standard age of concrete for the strength test
items.labelFr: Âge standard du béton pour l'essai de résistance
items.conditions: Concrete cylinders are cured in the laboratory and crushed at a test age that is typically 28 days, set by US paving specifications (AASHTO T22). Some specifications use 56 or 90 days.
items.conditionsFr: Les éprouvettes de béton sont conservées en laboratoire puis écrasées à un âge d'essai, typiquement 28 jours, fixé par les cahiers des charges routiers américains (AASHTO T22). Certains cahiers des charges retiennent 56 ou 90 jours.
items.quote: cured in water/moist room under standard laboratory conditions (73.5˚±3.5˚F) until test age, typically 28 days
items.confidenceNotes: Convention well established in practice; the source is FHWA, not the standard text itself (AASHTO/ASTM/EN standards were not opened).

items.labelEn: Operating life of an LED lamp
items.labelFr: Durée de fonctionnement d'une lampe LED
items.conditions: Lower bound: integrated LED lamps 'appear to be capable of at least 25,000 hours of operation'. Lifetime is usually defined as the time until light output drops to 70% (L70), not until the lamp goes dark. About 2.9 years if lit non-stop.
items.conditionsFr: Borne basse : les lampes LED intégrées semblent capables d'au moins 25 000 heures de fonctionnement. La durée de vie se définit en général comme le temps avant que la lumière baisse à 70 % (L70), pas avant l'extinction. Environ 2,9 ans si elle reste allumée en continu.
items.quote: integrated lamps appear to be capable of at least 25,000 hours of operation
items.confidenceNotes: Hedged wording ('appear to be capable of at least'). It is a floor, not a rated life; products are sold with ratings of 15,000 to 50,000 h, but those figures were not sourced here. A current energy.gov consumer page ('up to 25 times longer than incandescent') returned 404.

items.labelEn: Developing a new drug, from the lab to the pharmacy
items.labelFr: Développer un nouveau médicament, du laboratoire à la pharmacie
items.conditions: Upper end of the journey from discovery to an approved medicine (US). Many candidates fail along the way; the value is a ceiling, not an average.
items.conditionsFr: Haut de la fourchette pour le parcours de la découverte au médicament autorisé (États-Unis). Beaucoup de candidats échouent en route ; la valeur est un plafond, pas une moyenne.
items.quote: A new drug’s journey from the lab to the medicine cabinet can take up to 15 years.
items.confidenceNotes: Agency summary, not a study. Other NIH materials (not opened) give about 13 or 14 years or '10 to 15 years'. No low bound sourced, so low is null.

items.labelFr: Un match de football, temps réglementaire
items.conditions: Two halves of 45 minutes. Stoppage time, the half-time break (up to 15 min) and any extra time come on top.
items.conditionsFr: Deux mi-temps de 45 minutes. Le temps additionnel, la pause (15 min au plus) et une éventuelle prolongation s'y ajoutent.
items.quote: A match lasts for two equal halves of 45 minutes
items.confidenceNotes: Rule of the game (conventional). Explanation: 2 × 45 min = 90 min of regulation play; real elapsed time is longer. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: two halves of 45 min (Law 7.1); stoppage time and extra time excluded.

items.labelFr: Record du monde du 100 m masculin
items.conditions: Usain Bolt, Berlin Olympiastadion, 16 August 2009, electronic timing.
items.conditionsFr: Usain Bolt, Olympiastadion de Berlin, 16 août 2009, chronométrage électronique.
items.confidenceNotes: Official federation data. Quote is a table row (cells joined), not a sentence. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: reference value restated by the source, no protocol published there: classified documented.

items.conditions: 1:59:30 by Sabastian Kimaru Sawe, London, 26 April 2026. Shown in seconds (1 h 59 min 30 s).
items.conditionsFr: 1 h 59 min 30 s par Sabastian Kimaru Sawe, Londres, 26 avril 2026. Exprimé en secondes.
items.confidenceNotes: Measured mark converted to seconds. Top of the all-time list; whether it is already ratified as the world record was not confirmed (the world-records page rendered empty). Label it 'fastest' rather than 'world record' until ratification is checked. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: 1:59:30 converted to seconds (unit conversion, not a calculation).

items.labelFr: Se frotter les mains au lavage
items.conditions: Public-health recommendation: at least 20 seconds of scrubbing with soap.
items.conditionsFr: Recommandation de santé publique : au moins 20 secondes de frottement avec du savon.
items.quote: Scrub your hands for at least 20 seconds.
items.confidenceNotes: Recommendation (minimum), not a measurement. Page date not shown; era is approximate.

items.conditions: Recommended: twice a day, about 2 minutes each time.
items.conditionsFr: Recommandation : deux fois par jour, environ 2 minutes à chaque fois.
items.locator: How to keep your teeth clean, brushing advice
items.quote: Brush your teeth twice a day for about 2 minutes each time.

items.labelFr: Cuire un œuf à la coque
items.conditions: In its shell, in boiling water. Actual time depends on egg size, starting temperature and altitude; the source does not give a range.
items.conditionsFr: Dans sa coquille, dans l'eau bouillante. Le temps réel dépend de la taille de l'œuf, de sa température de départ et de l'altitude ; la source ne donne pas de fourchette.
items.quote: Soft-Cooked Eggs: Cook 7 minutes in the shell in boiling water.
items.confidenceNotes: Single extension-service value given with food-safety intent; cooking sites commonly give shorter times (4 to 6 min, not sourced here). Low/high left null because no sourced range. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: single cooking time recommended by the source (food-safety guidance): conventional, no range.

items.conditions: Percolation time in the 'Espresso Italiano' certification: 25 s ± 5 s, at 9 bar ± 1, for about 25 ml in the cup.
items.conditionsFr: Temps de percolation de la certification « Espresso Italiano » : 25 s ± 5 s, à 9 bar ± 1, pour environ 25 ml dans la tasse.
items.locator: Brochure, table of espresso parameters ('Percolation time')
items.confidenceNotes: Certification parameter from a private institute, read on a third-party-hosted copy of the brochure (original site not reached). low/high derived from the stated ± 5 s tolerance.

items.labelEn: Legal full-time working week in France
items.labelFr: Durée légale du travail à temps plein en France
items.conditions: Per week, private-sector employee working full time. It is the threshold for overtime, not a maximum.
items.conditionsFr: Par semaine, salarié du secteur privé à temps complet. C'est le seuil des heures supplémentaires, pas un maximum.
items.quote: La durée légale du travail pour un temps complet du salarié du secteur privée est fixée à : 35 heures par semaine
items.confidenceNotes: Legal rule. Quote joins a sentence and the bullet that follows it on the page.

items.labelFr: Durée maximale d'une journée de travail en France
items.conditions: Actual work per day, general rule for private-sector employees; derogations exist.
items.conditionsFr: Travail effectif par jour, règle générale pour les salariés du privé ; des dérogations existent.
items.quote: ne doit pas dépasser la durée maximale de 10 heures par jour
items.confidenceNotes: Legal rule; exceptions not detailed here.
